title: 熱壓接合
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入力—熱—位移耦合與接合後界面。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore force–temperature–displacement coupling and bonded interfaces, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 接觸設計
stages.description: 針對接觸設計完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for contact design, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 接合堆疊剖面｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Bond-stack cross-section | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對接合堆疊剖面，把「上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For bond-stack cross-section, turn "Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「接合堆疊剖面」的模型：上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for bond-stack cross-section: Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付接合堆疊剖面的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for bond-stack cross-section, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 接合堆疊剖面：機制
knowledge.text: 上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。
knowledge.textEn: Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 必須排除的錯判：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Misinterpretation to reject: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「接合堆疊剖面」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For bond-stack cross-section — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。
工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲
Z 回授位移就是每顆焊點壓縮量
optionsEn: Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes.
Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage
Equating Z feedback with each joint's compression
quiz.explanation: 上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。 畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 因此不能採用「工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲」。
quiz.explanationEn: Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes. Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Therefore reject: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage.

steps.title: 接合堆疊剖面｜證據與診斷
steps.titleEn: Bond-stack cross-section | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對接合堆疊剖面，把「上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。

steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 將「工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：工具平行即可消除堆疊的翹曲。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming parallel tools eliminate stack warpage. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付接合堆疊剖面的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for bond-stack cross-section: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 已知良品與面向｜機制與設計
steps.titleEn: Known-good die and orientation | mechanism and design
steps.objective: 針對已知良品與面向，把「接合後難以接近的節點須在前段建立電性與面向追溯，鏡像坐標錯誤可造成規則性開路。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For known-good die and orientation, turn "Nodes inaccessible after bonding need pre-bond electrical and orientation traceability; mirrored coordinates can produce systematic opens." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「已知良品與面向」的模型：接合後難以接近的節點須在前段建立電性與面向追溯，鏡像坐標錯誤可造成規則性開路。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「以非對稱標記驗證旋轉與翻面，對照良品地圖而非僅辨識條碼。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for known-good die and orientation: Nodes inaccessible after bonding need pre-bond electrical and orientation traceability; mirrored coordinates can produce systematic opens. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Verify rotation and flipping with asymmetric marks and compare known-good-die maps, not barcodes alone. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 以非對稱標記驗證旋轉與翻面，對照良品地圖而非僅辨識條碼。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Verify rotation and flipping with asymmetric marks and compare known-good-die maps, not barcodes alone. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：晶粒料號相同即可省略翻面座標檢查。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Skipping flip-coordinate checks for identical part numbers. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付已知良品與面向的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for known-good die and orientation, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 已知良品與面向：機制
knowledge.text: 接合後難以接近的節點須在前段建立電性與面向追溯，鏡像坐標錯誤可造成規則性開路。
knowledge.textEn: Nodes inaccessible after bonding need pre-bond electrical and orientation traceability; mirrored coordinates can produce systematic opens.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 以非對稱標記驗證旋轉與翻面，對照良品地圖而非僅辨識條碼。 必須排除的錯判：晶粒料號相同即可省略翻面座標檢查。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Verify rotation and flipping with asymmetric marks and compare known-good-die maps, not barcodes alone. Misinterpretation to reject: Skipping flip-coordinate checks for identical part numbers. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「已知良品與面向」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For known-good die and orientation — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 晶粒料號相同即可省略翻面座標檢查
高電阻一律表示加熱不足
接合後難以接近的節點須在前段建立電性與面向追溯，鏡像坐標錯誤可造成規則性開路。
optionsEn: Skipping flip-coordinate checks for identical part numbers
Attributing every high resistance to insufficient heating
Nodes inaccessible after bonding need pre-bond electrical and orientation traceability; mirrored coordinates can produce systematic opens.
quiz.explanation: 接合後難以接近的節點須在前段建立電性與面向追溯，鏡像坐標錯誤可造成規則性開路。 以非對稱標記驗證旋轉與翻面，對照良品地圖而非僅辨識條碼。 因此不能採用「晶粒料號相同即可省略翻面座標檢查」。
quiz.explanationEn: Nodes inaccessible after bonding need pre-bond electrical and orientation traceability; mirrored coordinates can produce systematic opens. Verify rotation and flipping with asymmetric marks and compare known-good-die maps, not barcodes alone. Therefore reject: Skipping flip-coordinate checks for identical part numbers.

knowledge.text: 總力除以名義面積只是平均；少數高凸塊先承載會造成局部過載與其餘接點未接觸。
knowledge.textEn: Force divided by nominal area is only an average; tall bumps can overload while other joints remain open.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 將柱高分布與接觸順序連結，檢查高低點的破面與電阻。 必須排除的錯判：固定總力可保證各凸塊同壓。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Link bump-height distribution to contact order and inspect fracture/resistance at high and low sites. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

steps.titleEn: Contact-pressure distribution | evidence and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對接觸壓力分布，把「總力除以名義面積只是平均；少數高凸塊先承載會造成局部過載與其餘接點未接觸。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For contact-pressure distribution, turn "Force divided by nominal area is only an average; tall bumps can overload while other joints remain open." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：將柱高分布與接觸順序連結，檢查高低點的破面與電阻。 將「固定總力可保證各凸塊同壓」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Link bump-height distribution to contact order and inspect fracture/resistance at high and low sites. Challenge the hypothesis "Assuming constant total force guarantees equal bump pressure" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 將柱高分布與接觸順序連結，檢查高低點的破面與電阻。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Link bump-height distribution to contact order and inspect fracture/resistance at high and low sites. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：固定總力可保證各凸塊同壓。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Assuming constant total force guarantees equal bump pressure. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付接觸壓力分布的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for contact-pressure distribution: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.
